vpc_architecture_fit: Preferred topology: Private control plane components deployed in customer VPC (account-owned) OR managed control plane with VPC peering - customer prefers customer-owned if feasible.
Subneting: workers in private subnets across 3 AZs; management/control plane in separate management subnets.
Inbound: minimal inbound - admin access via bastion/jump host over SSM/VPN; no public incoming traffic to inference workers.
Outbound: restricted egress only to approved Redwood endpoints (or to S3 endpoints) via NAT or egress proxy; must provide static IP ranges for firewall allow-listing.
Networking: prefer Transit Gateway for multi-VPC connectivity; consider VPC endpoints (S3, KMS) for traffic staying in the region.
Regions: production primary us-east-1, DR in us-west-2; data residency US-only for production storage/backups.
IAM/KMS: require CMEK via AWS KMS customer-managed CMKs or HSM/BYOK; Redwood must support key policies allowing decrypt for runtime but key material never exported.
Observability: audit logs (token-level, request metadata) exported to customer S3 bucket and forwarded to customer's SIEM (Splunk) - 7 year retention requested.
Backup/retention: backups must reside in US region; immutable retention policy preferred for regulated data.
Peering/PrivateLink: customer prefers PrivateLink endpoints if Redwood offers them to avoid cross-account peering complexity.
audit_logging_requirements: Immutable export to customer-owned S3 with lifecycle policies
SIEM integration via S3 or direct forwarder (Splunk)
kms_integration_notes: Primary requirement: BYOK with AWS KMS CMKs (customer-managed).
Acceptable: AWS KMS CMKs, HSM-backed keys via external HSM provider, or RedHatVault (TBD).
Key rotation: customer owns rotation schedule; Redwood must support rekey without service disruption.
Access model: least-privilege IAM role in customer account granted decrypt for inference runtime; audit trail for key usage required.
Ask from security: sample CloudFormation/terraform to create KMS key + key policy for PoC.
